titulo: I will do, I will be able, I will leave
intro: The irregular futures, and the rule for if.
p.haber.nota: Irregular future stem habr-; habrá stays singular in the standard impersonal construction.
p.dentro de: in (a period of time from now)
p.dentro de.nota: Dentro de dos años: two years from now.
p.valer: to be worth; to be valid
b1.texto:
The future endings are **-é, -ás, -á, -emos, -éis, -án**. These twelve common verbs have an irregular stem.

- drop a vowel: poder → **podr**é, saber → **sabr**é, querer → **querr**é, haber → **habr**á
- add **d**: tener → **tendr**é, venir → **vendr**é, poner → **pondr**é, salir → **saldr**é, valer → **valdr**é, caber → **cabr**é
- shorten: hacer → **har**é, decir → **dir**é

Use the future for predictions (**Mañana lloverá**) and promises (**Te llamaré**). For an arranged plan, **ir a + infinitive** is common: **Voy a comprar** un coche.

For a real condition, use **si + present** in the condition and a present, future or imperative in the result: **Si tengo tiempo, voy / iré / llámame**. In this pattern, the verb after **si** is not in the future.

**Dentro de** counts from now: **dentro de dos años**.
b3.f0: What will you be doing in five years?
b3.f1: I don't know. I'll have another job and I'll go out less.
b3.f2: If I save money, I'll be able to buy a house.
b3.f2.nota: In this real condition, use the present in the si-clause: si ahorro, not si ahorraré.
b3.f3: I'm sure there will be a lot of changes.
b3.f4: Some day I'll tell you my plans.
b5.pregunta: Complete: I will do it tomorrow.
b5.o1.refuerzo: The stem is har-, not hacer-.
b6.pregunta: Complete: if I have time, I'll go.
b6.o0.refuerzo: After si, Spanish uses the present.
b6.o1.refuerzo: In this real condition, use the present in the si-clause; the future goes in the result clause.
b6.o2.refuerzo: A real condition takes the indicative.
b7.o0.refuerzo: There will be: in the standard impersonal construction, habrá stays singular.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The standard impersonal form stays singular: habrá muchos cambios.
b8.pregunta: Write the yo future of salir.
b9.traduccion: Some day I'll tell you my plans.
b10.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Write about your life in ten years: where you will live, what you will do, what you will have.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain your plans for next year, using at least eight verbs in the future.
